verdict.rationale: telli's docs describe voice cloning that gives an agent a custom voice (your own, a colleague's, or a professional voice actor's) used on every call, which covers the core of cloning a brand voice for agents. However, nothing in the pack documents a consent process for the person whose voice is cloned; the only consent item covers callers agreeing to call recording, which is a different subject. Missing for 10: a documented voice-owner consent or verification process for cloning, details of the cloning workflow (sample requirements, setup steps), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
